say:3:1022033001:1.text: They've settled down. Gosh, these gruglins always rush in with clubs at the slightest hint of trouble!
say:3:1022033001:1.source_cn: 呼，总算老实下来了。这些咕布林，一言不合就拎着棍棒冲上来！
say:3:1022033001:1.male: They've settled down. Gosh, these gruglins always rush in with clubs at the slightest hint of trouble!
say:3:1022033001:1.female: They've settled down. Gosh, these gruglins always rush in with clubs at the slightest hint of trouble!

say:5:1022033003:1.text: Their leader has some intelligence, but communicating with them is still nearly impossible.
say:5:1022033003:1.source_cn: 这个首领似乎有点智慧……但，感觉也很难沟通。
say:5:1022033003:1.male: Their leader has some intelligence, but communicating with them is still nearly impossible.
say:5:1022033003:1.female: Their leader has some intelligence, but communicating with them is still nearly impossible.

say:6:1022033004:1.text: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!
say:6:1022033004:1.source_cn: 有冬青学会的学者专门研究咕布林的语言，但我们现在没办法...
say:6:1022033004:1.male: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!
say:6:1022033004:1.female: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!

choice_prompt:7:1022033004.text: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!
choice_prompt:7:1022033004.source_cn: 有冬青学会的学者专门研究咕布林的语言，但我们现在没办法立刻找到学者来当翻译呀！
choice_prompt:7:1022033004.male: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!
choice_prompt:7:1022033004.female: If only we had one of those scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory who study gruglin language!

say:11:1022033005:1.text: I've got an idea. If we can't talk it out, we'll show them we mean no harm with our actions. Let's offer some food as a sign of goodwill.
say:11:1022033005:1.source_cn: ……噢，我懂了，既然言语不能沟通，那就只能通过行动了。...
say:11:1022033005:1.male: I've got an idea. If we can't talk it out, we'll show them we mean no harm with our actions. Let's offer some food as a sign of goodwill.
say:11:1022033005:1.female: I've got an idea. If we can't talk it out, we'll show them we mean no harm with our actions. Let's offer some food as a sign of goodwill.

say:12:1022033006:1.text: Let's see what we can find.
say:12:1022033006:1.source_cn: 不错，应该可行……我们这就去找找看吧。
say:12:1022033006:1.male: Let's see what we can find.
say:12:1022033006:1.female: Let's see what we can find.

choice:7:0:1.text: If it's just about the food...
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 如果他们只是害怕食物短缺……
choice:7:0:1.male: If it's just about the food...
choice:7:0:1.female: If it's just about the food...
